description: Shape 4 (dense1024, full-rank n=1024) is noted in-code as STUCK on cuSOLVER — unlike n=1024 shapes 5/7 it gets no custom decomposition, so it pays the raw cuSOLVER syevd floor. Give it a custom path: matrix-sign divide-and-conquer splitting the 1024 at the median into two ~512 halves that route to the existing fast n<=512 reduced-block / med-kernel path (the same depth-1 sign-DC that works for the n=2048 shape 5 halves, applied one level up at n=1024). The dense full-rank spectrum means a single-sign projector P+/P- per half (clean selection, unlike the near-null multiway case). Targets the redundant-work of a full n=1024 cuSOLVER solve vs cheaper split leaves; keep the per-matrix residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback, route guarded per shape, watch shape 10 (other n=1024).

t2: route n=1024 dense (shape 4, PR~110) to depth-1 matrix-sign D&C via _eigh_sign_dc_large (2 x ~536-wide cluster halves), gated by tight dense PR band. REGRESSION: shape4 45702->167744us (+267%), geomean 27445->30302 (+10.4%). 167ms >> cuSOLVER floor => mass gate-fallback (sign-DC waste + full-n cuSOLVER redo stacked). The n=2048-tuned depth-1 machinery (margin 0.0234, 16 NS iters) does not clear the gate at n=1024. Shapes 10/12 flat (PR band excludes them). Diagnosing orth/eigr/fallback next.

t3: force n=1024 depth-1 split (base_max=836 -> two K=536 halves). Split fires but 100% FALLBACK (orth 3.03, eigr 0.72, nbad=60/60). ROOT CAUSE: sign(A-mean*I) split of dense1024 cond2 is LOPSIDED (n+ in [399,618], max_side=624) while K=536 undersizes the fat half -> Q rank-deficient. base_gstk_eigr=0.0015 (base solve OK); pure K-undersize on the fat side. shape4 171177us, geomean 30290. Fix next: raise K margin >= max_side, or median/Ritz shift for balance.

t4: raise n=1024 margin to 0.14 (K=656 >= max_side 625). K now covers fat side (base_gstk_orth 0.011, eigr 0.0016 CLEAN) but STILL 100% fallback: assembled Q orth 1.6, eigr 0.30, nbad=60/60. New failure: dense1024 semicircle has high eig density near mean shift sigma -> near-sigma eigvecs get fuzzy ~1e-2 cluster sign, leak into BOTH halves, global topk DOUBLE-PICKS -> near-duplicate cols. Same failure _SIGN_DC_COUNT_SELECT/_HALF_REORTH/_BASE_REORTH fix for n=2048 (all False). shape4 190784, geomean 30610. Enabling membership fixes next.

t5: enable membership fixes for n=1024 (HALF_REORTH=2, COUNT_SELECT, SIDE_MEMBERSHIP, BASE_REORTH=1) threaded via mem_kw (shape 5 untouched: s5 90201, n=2048 orth 5e-5 nbad 0/8). STILL 100% fallback at n=1024: orth 1.85 nbad=60/60 -- membership fixes did NOT help. Contrast: n=2048 split BALANCED (max_side 1028~m/2) clean; n=1024 LOPSIDED (max_side 627 vs 512) because sign(A-MEAN) != median for the asymmetric dense1024 cond2 spectrum. shape4 204877, geomean 30820. Root cause = the mean SHIFT (lopsided split) + fuzzy near-sigma sign, not membership. Ritz-median shift next.

t6: Ritz-MEDIAN shift for n=1024 split. Shift DID balance it (max_side 627->568, n+_range [456,563]) but STILL 100% fallback: orth 1.91, eigr 0.16, nbad=60/60. base_gstk clean (0.01/0.0015). Balance + K-cover + membership fixes do NOT fix assembly -- orth 1.91 = assembled Q columns non-orthonormal despite per-half reorth + count-select. shape4 288580 (Ritz added cost), geomean 31636. Near-sigma membership at n=1024 is the wall, intrinsic to the dense semicircle. Isolate balanced-split + plain topk next.

t7: crisper sign (NS 16->30) to sharpen n=1024 near-sigma membership. Did NOT help -- orth WORSE (1.9->5.17), nbad 51-60/60. max_side 600 (better balance) but assembly still rank-deficient; over-crisp sign near dense sigma flips columns. shape4 286631, geomean 31604. Strong evidence depth-1 sign-DC via _sign_dc_block_eigh membership assembly hits a WALL at n=1024 dense (rank-deficient Q). Next: apply the n=512 _sign_dc_solve structure (works for shape 11) at n=1024.

t8: 3-WAY split (nways=3) -> three ~342 med-kernel pieces (CRISP <=448 base vs binary's fuzzy cluster). BIG eigr improvement 0.16->0.032 (1.8x over 0.018 gate) -- eigenvalues nearly right with the crisp base. But orth STILL 3.6, nbad=60/60: 3-way membership picks right eigenpairs but assembled eigenvectors non-orthonormal (piece-boundary double-pick; multiway has NO per-piece reorth). shape4 248945, geomean 31266. shape5 90005 protected. Add per-piece reorth + count-select to multiway next.

t9: per-PIECE CQR reorth (=2) of 3-way candidate blocks. Did NOT fix orth (3.6->3.5 unchanged), eigr 0.032, nbad=60/60. DECISIVE: per-piece reorth cannot fix CROSS-piece duplicates -- Ritz-quantile shifts are estimates so adjacent bands overlap, a boundary eigenvector appears in TWO pieces (mem ~0.7 each), reorth within each piece keeps both copies, global topk picks BOTH -> duplicate col -> orth 3.5. shape4 256300, geomean 31351. shape5 90177 protected. The n=1024 dense assembly wall = cross-piece eigenvector leakage. Profiling shape4 split-cost-vs-cuSOLVER-floor next.

t10: COUNT-based per-piece selection for the 3-way (assign each eigenvalue to its Ritz band). Still 100% fallback: orth 4.0/NaN, nbad=60/60. NaN because sum_i(cnt_i) != m -- a boundary eigenvalue near a Ritz shift lands in neither/both bands (Ritz shifts are estimates, not exact gaps), leaving output cols uninitialized. Confirms the cross-piece boundary leak is INTRINSIC: neither global topk (double-pick) nor count-select (miscount) partitions the dense semicircle at n=1024. shape4 257386, geomean 31370. shape5 90015 protected. PROFILE (t10 nsys shape4): fallback=cuSOLVER geqr2 28.2%+syevd internals; wasted sign-DC=mega_eigh_med_split 6.1%+CQR. cuSOLVER floor MEASURED: shape4 106188us, shape10 104950, shape12 102085 -- shape4's CURRENT low-rank path (45702) is ALREADY 2.32x under cuSOLVER (brief premise that shape4 pays raw cuSOLVER is FALSE).

t11: ALSO route shape 10 (nearrank1024, PR~326) through sign-DC (brief-requested). Shape 10 behaves SAME as dense: 100% fallback, orth 3.6-4.0, eigr up to 1.49, nbad=60/60 -> 90763->256158us. Near-rank sign-DC assembly fails identically (rank-deficient Q). geomean 33929 (s4 257031 + s10 256158 regressed; s12 30404 flat/protected). The membership/count-select cannot cleanly partition ANY n=1024 spectrum (dense OR near-rank); cross-band boundary leak is intrinsic. Both shapes' EXISTING low-rank routes (s4 45702=2.32x under cuSOLVER 106188, s10 90763=1.16x under 104950) already beat what sign-DC delivers.

BRIEF PREMISE FALSIFIED + sign-DC assembly wall mapped at n=1024 (10 trials, t2-t11). KEY FACT: shape 4 (dense1024) does NOT pay the raw cuSOLVER floor -- trial-1 nsys shows NO syevd/sytrd; it already runs a low-rank k=608 peel + C=2 cluster (mega_eigh_clust_split_k 44.8%) at 45702us = 2.32x under the MEASURED cuSOLVER floor 106188us. Shape 10 nearrank1024 = 90763us = 1.16x under 104950us; shape 12 lapgeom = 29940 = 3.41x. So the bar to beat is 45702us (s4) / 90763us (s10), NOT ~106000. THE MECHANISM: built the depth-1 matrix-sign D&C route via _eigh_sign_dc_large (threaded base_max/margin/mem_kw/nways so shape 5 n=2048 stays UNTOUCHED -- verified s5 flat ~90000 every trial). The n=1024 SPLIT works (Ritz-median shift balances it, max_side 627->568->600), and the reduced-block BASE solve is clean (base_gstk orth 0.01, eigr 0.0015). But the ASSEMBLY (membership rank-select of the m eigenpairs from the oversized bases) FAILS on EVERY variant -> rank-deficient assembled Q -> 100% cuSOLVER fallback -> 167-288us (WORSE than raw cuSOLVER because the wasted split + full-n cuSOLVER redo stack). Variants tried, all nbad=60/60: mean-shift K=536 (orth 3.0, undersized fat side); K=656 covering max_side (orth 1.6); +HALF_REORTH+COUNT_SELECT+SIDE_MEMBERSHIP (orth 1.9); Ritz-median balanced split (orth 1.9); crisper sign NS 16->30 (orth 5.2, WORSE); 3-way med-kernel base crisp <=448 (eigr 0.16->0.032 NEARLY passing but orth 3.6); +per-piece reorth (orth 3.5, no change -- can't fix CROSS-piece dup); +count-based per-piece select (NaN -- Ritz shifts don't partition exactly). ROOT CAUSE: the dense1024/nearrank1024 spectra have too many near-sigma / band-boundary eigenvalues; a boundary eigenvector leaks into two pieces with membership ~0.7 each, global topk double-picks (dup column) and count-select miscounts (missing column) -- neither partitions the dense semicircle cleanly, and per-piece reorth cannot remove a cross-piece duplicate. The n=2048 shape-5 path works only because its cond1 spectrum is symmetric (balanced mean-shift) AND less near-sigma-dense. This matches the in-code brief-47-t7 note (2-way sign split of the k=608 reduced block was +71-96%) -- same assembly failure one level down. shape 10 behaves IDENTICALLY to dense (t11: 90763->256158, orth 3.6-4.0). ENGINEERING LEFT OPEN (I did not reach): (1) the 3-way eigr=0.032 is only 1.8x over the 0.018 gate -- a genuinely EXACT count (solve the K x K reduced eigenvalues, count those < each Ritz shift with a small guard band, then reproject any unassigned column) MIGHT close it, but even a clean 3-way is ~3x14ms med-kernel = 42ms + CQR/lift scaffolding, already >= s4's 45702 low-rank floor, so a WIN is unlikely; (2) NOT a sign-DC angle -- shape 4's real lever is the low-rank path's k=608 C=2 CLUSTER (44.8%) + CQR2 batch_trsm (13.1%): a cheaper k=608 inner solve (2-CTA/SM cluster is disabled after brief-95 found the cl.sync latency dominates; a genuinely batched dense tensor-core tridiag for k in (448,836] is the open kernel), or shrinking k below 608 if the dense1024 effective rank allows; (3) shape 10 k=768 C=3 cluster is the analogous lever at 1.16x.
